d902647175298838: When it improves readability of the subject or leaves room for later text.
c4b56bc057555f9b: The style looks right, but the product is too small. What should you review?
217546ee552d0ad4: The frame layout and the subject’s scale.
4cdeb22bfec9bb15: Does a vertical photo necessarily have more definition than a square one?
0aa9cfa446871816: No. Format and pixel count are different measures.
e2aedcf3745d3c43: Why separate a product reference from an atmosphere reference?
509615e7fce79c38: To keep the scene’s appearance from changing the object’s identity.
9bab8387cfd25e24: The tool accepts only one reference. Which do you prioritize for a catalog?
4d77f2d1ef02916f: The product reference, because its shape needs to remain recognizable.
80db30455d440b0b: A tutorial shows a setting that is missing from your account. What should you do?
b9f801e0a8aa1a15: Check the features in your own interface and work with what is available.
521ef3fa3becfee1: Why avoid increasing every setting at once?
91379ff3c83fabe3: Because the result will not show which change caused the difference.
71b708fb6a446b13: What observation matters more than a high setting value?
cc0e9ee418e73dcc: Whether the setting improved your chosen criterion without damaging necessary characteristics.
ee777b7134fe1bd6: Does the same starting number preserve a face across different models?
c11413fc7af052f6: No. It does not replace an identity reference.
b4fff07287786ad8: What makes a saved setting useful to someone else?
7e4e9f9782de29c6: Instructions, references, known conditions, and clear evaluation criteria.
4599df3b9d1864bf: How should you document an unavailable setting?
d9e570ca4dd0536c: Record that it was not available in that interface.
3cfface63dea7eae: What can vary without losing the product’s identity?
3cd506681eea1215: The setting and framing, as long as the fixed characteristics remain.
db09296e2478b35f: Why review the reference before producing an entire campaign?
a118dda8358adeab: Because flaws in the base can spread to every scene.
ed42ffd7e666550c: Which photo is more useful: dramatic or clear?
17f254e75c5ee59c: To establish identity, choose the one that clearly shows the necessary characteristics.
deb6741d36aa68e2: How can you use a setting photo without changing the product’s identity?
029d771528f12c20: Explicitly assign each reference its role.
55639f171f354715: Why give each frame a purpose before generating?
f6347990f8e2e5da: To prevent repetition and check whether the sequence communicates what is missing.
2380cf687f09f7d7: Which scene helps you see the object’s scale?
bada68f46ce02ddb: A use scene with a recognizable relationship, such as a hand holding the mug.
95917723ab6bdf40: Why look at the thumbnails together?
8c36920009ab6467: To notice the unity of the product, scale, light, and palette across the set.
599efa114fc07df8: Is every different framing a consistency error?
fae9611397257891: No. Variation can be planned; the product needs to remain recognizable.
1354e7dc86497b0c: What should accompany a localized correction request?
b71323d48779efc8: A list of what must stay the same to protect the parts that are already approved.
1b2978c4bc08c423: When does a global adjustment make sense?
55bc271b4445dbf3: When the problem affects the whole image, such as overall exposure.
32293b8125ac756d: What should you look for at the edge of a reconstructed area?
9c6e352a4dcd3885: Seams, texture differences, and unwanted cuts into the object.
980a5f0bd89ecbad: Why preserve the shadow when correcting the background?
9b93dd6e4f8d89a7: Because it helps maintain contact and makes the object fit the surface.
6b6a0642324b208e: Why not stretch the object to change the image format?
1036d40cb151a674: Because that changes its proportions. It is better to crop or expand the setting to fit the intended use.
acf52cab9aef0696: Does the background created beyond the photo prove what the location looked like?
d86e5e4a9bb2346a: No. It is content invented by the expansion.
185428d389b00a4d: What clues help an inserted object fit into a scene?
e574cfe6a978fc7d: Consistent scale, perspective, light, and contact shadow.
ab18dbc24d061a95: Which version should you save before adding a caption?
b70e9597b897a589: The clean image, without text, so you can create new layouts.
be5cdad9e169fcad: How can you avoid a misleading before-and-after?
f285bc8abc2dd644: Compare versions at the same size and crop, and state what changed.
0ee5048e1f5838d9: Where should you check whether a title is readable?
84a26789e94a896f: At the size and on the device planned for final use.
4a1b1bd30f2912e5: Does adding more pixels guarantee recovery of original information?
5e69dba046c2396b: No. Some detail may be estimated or created.
efafa81ebf84b5e6: What determines an appropriate delivery size?
09181eab149c6d42: The destination and its requirements, not simply the largest available size.
e62a37dbd01452d8: How should you evaluate new texture after enlargement?
7e54c99b16cd61c8: Compare it with a reliable reference and decide whether the change is acceptable for the intended use.
f9c9494e55b95206: What problem should you fix before enlarging a mug?
9c9f066c05229b22: Its outline, proportions, and correct number of parts.
8d3ed297c3c84ac0: What question does a thumbnail answer best?
02b1c3b20ddd6831: Is the main subject recognizable and visually prominent?
463bd66c8aa2f150: Why view the image at publication size?
6d4b917156e12b41: Because that is the size at which readability and details need to work for the audience.
5c52ef92290a6cd0: Why open the file after exporting it?
edd6c12b96650728: Because the copy may have changes in quality or dimensions.
4f77ea694caf7cd2: Is the smallest file always the best deliverable?
ee145129decc1edd: No. It needs to retain the quality required for its use.
41a1b1f65a9fd9e5: Which version lets you correct a deliverable later?
e86271dc0d23105a: The preserved original, along with the record and materials used.
1241085710381996: What shows that a project has a clear endpoint?
6d9e9b34cd9533ef: Deliverables, criteria, and an attempt limit defined before production.
c49c79805a960a68: How do you choose a useful variation among three pieces?
d2accd2266993a5e: Give each framing a different purpose.
7b256e770b26892e: Will a fourth piece fix the rejection of the third?
3c8fff3a086ab4f0: No. First correct the piece that needs it or reconsider the scope with a reason.
adff7c80f103a27a: What should accompany each evaluation score?
9d1274d82a0d52c4: Observable evidence tied to the criterion.
9dbcd3fe7f3cac14: How can you show a revision without making a vague promise of improvement?
7ae8339e65be1786: Name the flaw, the change made, and the result you checked.
86071c6b930f143c: Can a high average make up for a flaw that prevents use?
ce16c3b030ec1e67: No. An essential problem, such as the wrong product, needs to be fixed.
27347011b12f1b7d: What organization keeps someone from publishing a rejected attempt?
b3b457428d43b01c: Separate approved finals from working versions and name the files clearly.
11f833baccaa567e: What evidence shows independence after the course?
d832981670bd59a9: Being able to justify choices, recognize flaws, and plan corrections without copying instructions.
a4a18730f4cbbabf: How should you present a piece that has not been produced yet?
cad2a1027f3c6431: As a plan or pending item, describing what remains to finish it.
